text:
maya: Heads up — ACME pilot asking for higher per-route throughput + a negotiated ceiling instead of commits. Want to capture what we can offer without breaking SLA math. Thoughts?
jeff: Can we get their 95th p95 token/sec peaks? need numbers to model.
tara: Sales said they expect spikes up to 3x baseline for onboarding week. They want a hard cap they can pay for (not softburst).
maya: Right — buyer prefers predictability. Options: (A) fixed slab with reserved qps + burst tokens, (B) committed capacity with surge credits, (C) per-route limit + overage pricing.
elena: Finance prefers model B for predictability of revenue and easier forecasting. Surge credits map to deferred recognition rules we already use.
sam: From infra POV, slab (A) is easiest to implement — allocate pool per tenant and enforce qps. But we need autoscale rules for tails or we risk QoS bleed.
jeff: For pricing, we could do: baseline commit price P, plus bursts sold at X cents/1000 tokens, capped at N tokens/day. Would that satisfy them?
tara: ACME hates per-token surprise. They asked for a daily hard cap and an overage threshold they can opt into.
maya: Proposal: pilot offer = committed baseline (30k units/mo) + optional burst pack (50k burst tokens/mo) at fixed price; burst can be burned but not exceeded. If they exceed, route to fallback model variant (lower-cost), not blocking.
elena: Add clause: 30 day review to convert to reserved if sustained >60% of burst usage. Accounting ok.
sam: Need to confirm runtime fallback behavior: auto-failover to model-lite and preserve request semantics where possible. That's work — estimate 2 sprints.
jeff: Also propose SLA carveouts for known fallback windows. We should document latency delta between variants.
tara: Sales wants a single-line offer sheet they can sign in pilot: baseline + burst pack + fallback behavior + 30d review.
maya: Action items: jeff to draft price bands and cap math; sam to scope runtime changes and fallback playbook; elena to draft accounting/legal clause for review conversion; tara to confirm ACME acceptable wording. I'll sync with customer.
ops-bot: Reminder: create pilot config ticket #PILOT-245 in product backlog.
jeff: I'll have a first-pass price band by EOD Thursday.
sam: I'll post a short scope doc and list of required infra tickets by Monday.
elena: Will loop in legal on the conversion clause today.
tara: I'll ping ACME legal and loop back.
maya: Cool — sync Friday standup 10:30 to finalize docs. :thumbsup:
